finalText:
**Migration is done.** 12 files still used the old call, 36 sites in all.

They now read `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the files migrated earlier.

Two things I deliberately left alone. `cache.query` is the cache's own lookup by key, not SQL. `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` is vendored, so it gets replaced on upgrade.

`node verify.js` passes.

```
OK every db.query call site moved to db.execute, and nothing else moved
```
